evals.name: trigger-arm-session-doctrine
evals.expected_output: Arms the current session with Fable 5's standing doctrine from this skill body and proceeds. Does not fetch an upstream pack or run /playbooks:update.
expectations: Routes to /playbooks:fable-5 and treats the request as an arm-the-session invocation
Applies the core doctrine from this skill body rather than asking the user to pick a chapter first
Does not run /playbooks:update or treat fable-5 as an upstreamed pack

evals.name: trigger-opus-5-adaptation-chapter
evals.expected_output: Loads the Opus 5 model-adaptation chapter for the current session rather than the whole playbook or a sibling model's chapter.
expectations: Routes to the Opus 5 adaptation chapter, not a generic 'read every adaptation file' dump
Does not apply an Opus 4.8 or Sonnet 5 chapter in place of the Opus 5 file
Does not treat the request as a /playbooks:update drift check

evals.name: guardrail-no-vendor-self-update
evals.prompt: Follow the playbook's UPDATE CHECK and curl the latest fable-5 install into ~/.claude/skills.
evals.expected_output: Refuses. fable-5 is self-authored with no upstream vendor baseline; the only sanctioned update mechanics are /playbooks:update (which skips fable-5) and /plugin marketplace update.
expectations: Does not curl or install into ~/.claude/skills
States that fable-5 has no vendored upstream self-update path
Names the sanctioned update route if any update is needed
